description: This is a C# source file defining a database migration for Entity Framework Core. It sets up the initial database schema including creation of sequences, tables (such as Baskets, CatalogBrands, CatalogTypes, Orders, BasketItems, Catalog, OrderItems), setting primary keys, foreign keys, and indexes.

classes.name: InitialModel
classes.description: A partial class inheriting from Migration, representing the initial database schema migration.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the operations to apply the migration, creating sequences and tables with their respective columns, constraints, and indexes.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Defines the operations to revert the migration, dropping the tables and sequences created in Up.
